name: Cathedral of the Interstice
desc: The **Cathedral of the Interstice** is a sub-location in [The City of the Drowned](location:the_city_of_the_drowned) located in the [First Layer](location:first_layer). It is the main way for a player to escape the Depths through the Depths Trial. It contains the [Shrine of Courage](entity:shrine_of_courage) and NPCs named [Andrea](entity:andrea) and [Petris](entity:petris), although Petris is technically outside the Cathedral. Inside the Trial also contains the [Voices of the Depths](entity:voices_of_the_depths), God-like beings who are seemingly testing the player on whether they are worthy of escaping [The Depths](location:the_depths).
additional_info:
-   An old preferred method of entering the Cathedral was climbing [Celtor City's](location:the_city_of_the_drowned) walls, either through using a Glider from a high vantage point, or by stacking Barrels and climbing the wall that way, and then dropping down to the entrance.
-   The west entrance of the Cathedral, where the elevator is, used to cost 25 Notes as a toll for each use.
